messages:
Jordan: Quick idea — can we try a frictionless handoff format for weekly triage? instead of doing one long 45m call, I propose: 15m quick triage (clear blockers + owner swaps), 15m owner updates, 15m deep bug dive / RFC pick. keeps it predictable and lets people drop after updates. thoughts?
Maya: +1 to shorter blocks. also suggest a rotating deep-dive owner so we actually get one RFC/design reviewed each month.
Samir: Sounds good. small ask: can we move it 30m earlier on Wed? 11:00 conflicts with customer meetings for a few folks.
Lei: 11->10:30 works for me. weekly cadence is fine. for rotation, I'll make a small owners sheet. quick snippet for calendar invite:```WED 10:30-11:15 PT
Agenda:
- 10:30-10:45 quick triage (new bugs, hotfixes)
- 10:45-11:00 owner updates (rollouts, blocks)
- 11:00-11:15 deep bug/RFC pick (owner-led)```
Tess: FYI I can post the agenda pinned in #eng every Tue 17:00 PT if you want a reminder. :bell:
Jordan: Nice. Lei — can you add a column for 'handoff' and 'backup owner' in the sheet so coverage is explicit? example row: `bug-1234 | Samir | Lei (backup) | next-step: revert if perf regresses`
Lei: yup will do. sharing sheet link shortly: https://sheets.internal/redwood/triage-owners (private)
Samir: One more: can we add a lightweight policy for when to escalate to dedicated incident channel vs triage? last time a perf blip sat in triage and got slower attention.
Maya: Good call. Proposed rule: Sev≥2 or user-facing latency spike -> #incidents + notify oncall, triage will still meet to coordinate followups. If it's a small config bug, keep it in #eng triage.
Jordan: love that. can we capture that as a single bullet in the pinned agenda so people know where to post?
Tess: Done — will pin the one-liner and set a recurring reminder 24h before the meeting to add items.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: Weekly triage (Wed 10:30 PT) — pinging owners list.
Maya: ok I'm +1. who wants to pilot the new format this week? I can run quick triage and Samir can own the deep-dive if there are candidates.
Samir: I can. I'll pull two candidate bugs and one RFC for the deep-dive slot.
Jordan: Perfect. I'll update the calendar and invite the rotation list. If anyone sees a conflict after invite lands, react with :x: in this thread and we can swap owners.
Lei: Added owners to sheet and prepopulated next 4 weeks. pinged owners.
Maya: Thanks all — excited to try compact flow. small win for async-first teams. :rocket:
